item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 27/Jul/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The weather will be very hot over Guangdong today. Showers triggered by high temperatures will affect the region. Meanwhile, a broad trough of low pressure will bring showers to the central part of the South China Sea. The broad trough of low pressure will edge closer to the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of Guangdong early this week. There will be showers and thunderstorms over the region. Under the influence of an active southwesterly airstream, the weather will remain unsettled over the coast of southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week.
